verdict.rationale: Puzzle has an accountant-facing offering that mentions migrating 'your client's data' and supports managing multiple companies under one login. That implies outside accountants can work inside a client's books. However, no evidence documents inviting an external user or assigning scoped roles or permissions. missing for 10: documented user-invite flow for external accountants/bookkeepers, role-based or scoped permission controls, evidence that invited users can adjust entries under restricted access, independent corroboration.
